title: Stablecoin Runs and the Centralization of Arbitrage
title_zh: 稳定币挤兑与套利活动的中心化
title_primary: 稳定币挤兑与套利活动的中心化
title_secondary: Stablecoin Runs and the Centralization of Arbitrage
authors: Yiming Ma, Yao Zeng, Anthony Lee Zhang
official: 官方在线 2026-09-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Stablecoins are cryptoassets designed to be pegged to the dollar, but they are backed by imperfectly liquid USD assets. We show that stablecoins feature concentrated arbitrage: the largest issuer, Tether, allows only six agents in an average month to redeem stablecoins for cash. We argue that the issuers’ choice of arbitrage concentration reflects a trade-off: efficient arbitrage improves stablecoin price stability in secondary markets but amplifies run risks by reducing investors’ price impact from selling stablecoins. Our findings imply that policies designed to improve stablecoin price stability may have the unintended consequence of increasing stablecoin run risks. (JEL G01, G23)
abstract_zh: 稳定币是一种旨在与美元挂钩的加密资产，但其背后支撑的是流动性不完全的美元资产。我们研究表明，稳定币具有集中的套利特征：最大的发行方Tether，在平均每月仅允许六个代理将稳定币兑换为现金。我们认为，发行方对套利集中度的选择反映了一种权衡：高效的套利能提升稳定币在二级市场的价格稳定性，但通过降低投资者出售稳定币时的价格冲击，反而加剧了挤兑风险。我们的发现意味着，旨在改善稳定币价格稳定性的政策可能带来增加稳定币挤兑风险的意外后果。（JEL G01, G23）

title: DP16905 Price Pressure Indices, Innovation and Mergers Between Commonly Owned Firms
title_zh: 价格压力指数、创新与共同所有权企业间的并购
title_primary: 价格压力指数、创新与共同所有权企业间的并购
title_secondary: DP16905 Price Pressure Indices, Innovation and Mergers Between Commonly Owned Firms
official: 官方在线 2022-01-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The potentially anticompetitive effects of common ownership are being discussed controversially. While the US agencies still display reluctance, the Commission has already invoked common ownership has part of a theory of harm in Dow/DuPont and Bayer/Monsanto. In our paper we focus on how common ownership can bear on the application of price pressure indices in unilateral effects analysis of horizontal mergers between portfolio companies. We do not assess whether the underlying premise of common ownership to lead to an internalization of shareholders’ expectations of high overall market returns is convincing. Rather, we hypothesize such common shareholder influence. Our main conclusion is that common ownership should still not be considered a general circumstantial factor indicating competitive harm with respect to post-merger price increases or effects on innovation competition. Rather, it calls for case-by-case analysis.
abstract_zh: 共同所有权可能产生的反竞争效应正引发争议性讨论。尽管美国监管机构仍持谨慎态度，欧盟委员会已在陶氏杜邦合并案及拜耳孟山都合并案中，将共同所有权作为损害理论的一部分加以援引。本文聚焦于共同所有权如何影响横向并购中组合公司单边效应分析中价格压力指数的应用。我们并未评估共同所有权导致股东对高整体市场回报预期内部化这一基本前提是否令人信服，而是假设存在此类共同股东影响力。我们的主要结论是，共同所有权仍不应被视为普遍的情节因素，用以指示并购后价格上涨或创新竞争效应方面的竞争损害，而应依据具体案例进行分析。

title: Dust in the Wind: Causes and Consequences of Managerial Replacements
title_zh: 风中之尘：管理层更替的原因与后果
title_primary: 风中之尘：管理层更替的原因与后果
title_secondary: Dust in the Wind: Causes and Consequences of Managerial Replacements
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: If the economic performance of a firm is disappointing, the manager may be replaced. Whether that improves performance is unclear. For regular firms, it is often difficult to study the causes and consequences of managerial replacement due to limited data availability. This is different for sports clubs, where high-quality data are available on a regular basis. The current paper studies managerial replacements in professional football in the Netherlands. Disappointment is measured by two indicators that use bookmaker expectations as a reference. Points surprise is based on actual results, while performance surprise is based on expected goals. The analysis shows that within-season managerial replacements are more likely when there is disappointment, that is, when both surprise indicators are negative. Match results improve after managerial replacement. However, this improvement is not causal: a counterfactual analysis suggests that match results would have improved even in the absence of managerial replacement.
abstract_zh: 如果企业经济表现令人失望，经理可能会被替换。这种替换是否能改善业绩尚不明确。对于普通企业而言，由于数据可得性有限，研究管理层更替的原因及后果往往较为困难。而体育俱乐部则不同，其高质量数据定期可得。本文研究了荷兰职业足球中的管理层更替现象。失望程度通过两个以博彩公司预期为基准的指标来衡量：积分意外基于实际比赛结果，而表现意外则基于预期进球数。分析显示，当出现失望情况，即两个意外指标均为负值时，赛季内管理层更替的可能性更高。管理层更替后，比赛结果有所改善。然而，这种改善并非因果关系：反事实分析表明，即使没有管理层更替，比赛结果也会有所提升。

title: Proximity to Fast-Food Outlets and Adolescent z-BMI: Accounting for Persistent Health Dynamics
title_zh: 靠近快餐店与青少年z-BMI：考虑持续性健康动态
title_primary: 靠近快餐店与青少年z-BMI：考虑持续性健康动态
title_secondary: Proximity to Fast-Food Outlets and Adolescent z-BMI: Accounting for Persistent Health Dynamics
authors: Aoki, Yu (University of Aberdeen), Arulampalam, Wiji (University of Warwick), Lloyd, Neil (University of St Andrews)
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We estimate the causal effect of exposure to fast-food outlets on adolescent z-BMI using the UK Millennium Cohort Study linked to comprehensive geospatial data. We develop a novel approach to modelling z-BMI persistence by clustering early childhood z-BMI trajectories, allowing us to distinguish baseline obesity susceptibility from contemporaneous environmental effects. Identification exploits the near-universal transition from primary to secondary school, generating plausibly exogenous variation in exposure to fast-food outlets around schools. We find that adolescents with at least one major-brand outlet near school have, on average, a 0.158 standard-deviation higher z-BMI. Effects decline with distance, are limited around the home, and do not extend to other food outlets.
abstract_zh: 我们利用英国千禧队列研究结合全面的地理空间数据，估计了接触快餐店对青少年z-BMI的因果效应。我们开发了一种新方法，通过聚类早期儿童z-BMI轨迹来建模z-BMI的持续性，从而能够区分基线肥胖易感性与同期环境效应。识别策略利用了从小学到中学近乎普遍的过渡，这为学校周边快餐店接触提供了看似外生的变异。我们发现，学校附近至少有一家主要品牌快餐店的青少年，其z-BMI平均高出0.158个标准差。效应随距离增加而减弱，仅限于家庭周边，且不延伸至其他食品店。

title: The impact of digital finance on manufacturing industry chain resilience: a labour market perspective
title_zh: 数字金融对制造业产业链韧性的影响：基于劳动力市场的视角
title_primary: 数字金融对制造业产业链韧性的影响：基于劳动力市场的视角
title_secondary: The impact of digital finance on manufacturing industry chain resilience: a labour market perspective
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Strengthening manufacturing industry chain resilience has become a strategic priority for China amid global supply-chain restructuring. This article investigates whether and how digital finance enhances manufacturing industry chain resilience, with particular attention to threshold-dependent nonlinearities shaped by labour market conditions. Using panel data on 30 Chinese provinces from 2011 to 2022, we employ two-way fixed-effects regressions, instrumental variable (IV) estimation and panel threshold models. The results show that digital finance significantly enhances manufacturing industry chain resilience. This effect is nonlinear: it intensifies in a stepwise manner as digital finance develops. Human capital amplifies the effect once average schooling exceeds a critical threshold, whereas labour market segmentation weakens it beyond a corresponding threshold. The benefits are also more pronounced in provinces with well-developed digital infrastructure and larger manufacturing scale. This study is the first to identify labour market segmentation as a threshold variable in the digital finance–resilience nexus. Theoretically, it shows that the resilience dividend of digital finance is conditional on both its own maturity and labour market institutions; practically, it offers guidance for sequencing digital finance and labour market reforms across regions. KEYWORDS: Digital finance industry chain resilience threshold effect human capital labour market segmentation JEL CLASSIFICATION: G21 L60 J24 R12
abstract_zh: 在全球供应链重构背景下，增强制造业产业链韧性已成为中国的战略优先事项。本文考察数字金融是否以及如何提升制造业产业链韧性，特别关注劳动力市场条件所塑造的门限依赖型非线性特征。基于2011至2022年中国30个省份的面板数据，本文采用双向固定效应回归、工具变量（IV）估计和面板门限模型。研究结果表明，数字金融显著增强制造业产业链韧性。该效应具有非线性特征：随着数字金融的发展，其效应呈阶梯式增强。当平均受教育年限超过临界阈值时，人力资本会放大该效应；而当劳动力市场分割超过相应阈值时，则会削弱该效应。此外，在数字基础设施完善和制造业规模较大的省份，该效应更为显著。本研究首次将劳动力市场分割识别为数字金融—韧性关联中的门限变量。在理论上，本文揭示了数字金融的韧性红利取决于其自身成熟度与劳动力市场制度的双重条件；在实践上，为各地区数字金融与劳动力市场改革的时序安排提供了政策参考。关键词：数字金融；产业链韧性；门限效应；人力资本；劳动力市场分割 JEL分类号：G21 L60 J24 R12

title: Inflation Targeting under Imperfect Knowledge
title_zh: 不完全信息下的通胀目标制
title_primary: 不完全信息下的通胀目标制
title_secondary: Inflation Targeting under Imperfect Knowledge
authors: Athanasios Orphanides, John C Williams, Philip Coyle, Naoki Maezono, Taisuke Nakata 等
official: 官方在线 2006-05-28 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: this paper, we reexamine the role of key elements of the inflation targeting framework towards this end, in the context of an economy where economic agents have an imperfect understanding of the macroeconomic landscape within which the public forms expectations and policymakers must formulate and implement monetary policy. Using an estimated model of the U.S. economy, we show that monetary policy rules that would perform well under the assumption of rational expectations can perform very poorly when we introduce imperfect knowledge. We then examine the performance of an easily implemented policy rule that incorporates three key characteristics of inflation targeting: transparency, commitment to maintaining price stability, and close monitoring of inflation expectations, and find that all three play an important role in assuring its success. Our analysis suggests that simple difference rules in the spirit of Knut Wicksell excel at tethering inflation expectations to the central bank?s goal and in so doing achieve superior stabilization of inflation and economic activity in an environment of imperfect knowledge.
abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了通胀目标框架中关键要素的作用，研究对象设定为经济主体对宏观经济环境存在不完全认知的经济体——在此环境中，公众形成预期，政策制定者必须制定并实施货币政策。通过使用美国经济估计模型，我们证明：在理性预期假设下表现良好的货币政策规则，在引入不完全知识后可能表现极差。随后，我们检验了一种易于实施的政策规则的表现，该规则包含通胀目标的三个核心特征：透明度、维持价格稳定的承诺以及对通胀预期的密切监测。研究发现，这三个特征对其成功实施均具有重要作用。我们的分析表明，遵循克努特·维克塞尔精神的简单差分规则，在将通胀预期锚定至央行目标方面表现卓越，从而在不完全知识环境下实现了通胀与经济活动的更优稳定。

title: Who Knows? Information Access and Endogenous Network Formation
title_zh: 谁知道？信息获取与内生网络形成
title_primary: 谁知道？信息获取与内生网络形成
title_secondary: Who Knows? Information Access and Endogenous Network Formation
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Applied Economics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Networks play a key role in information diffusion. Yet, the impact of information on network formation is not well understood. We conducted a randomized experiment in Malawian boarding secondary schools, providing one fifth of students with exclusive access to an online information source. Using a complete panel of detailed network data, we show that changes in information access affect network structure, as students form and maintain strategic links. At the endline, treated students are more well-connected than control students. We calibrate and simulate a model of strategic network formation to demonstrate implications for network-based targeting, information diffusion, academic welfare and inequality.
abstract_zh: 网络在信息扩散中扮演关键角色。然而，信息对网络形成的影响尚未得到充分理解。我们在马拉维寄宿制中学开展了一项随机实验，为五分之一的学生提供独家在线信息源。通过使用完整的详细网络数据面板，我们发现信息获取的变化会影响网络结构，因为学生会建立并维持战略性联系。在终期评估中，受干预学生比对照组学生拥有更广泛的社交网络。我们校准并模拟了一个战略性网络形成模型，以展示其对基于网络的定向干预、信息扩散、学业福利及不平等现象的影响。

title: Insurance with Multiple Actors
title_zh: 多方参与的保险
title_primary: 多方参与的保险
title_secondary: Insurance with Multiple Actors
authors: Abaluck, Jason, Sarig, Oren, Song, Jintaek
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We analyze how social-planner insurers split cost-sharing between consumers and firms (e.g. patients and doctors, or drivers and car mechanics). With no contracting frictions, firm cost-sharing can replace consumer cost-sharing other than “visit copays.” Optimal firm contracts depend on the marginal rate of substitution between consumer and firm cost-sharing. For Medicare physician services, paying physicians more up front but less as spending increases reduces risk for both patients and providers; in our calibration, net benefits are twice those from eliminating Medigap externality. For prescription drugs, a dollar of physician paperwork costs is 45–110 times more impactful than a dollar of consumer cost-sharing.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了社会规划型保险公司如何在消费者与企业（例如患者与医生，或驾驶员与汽车修理工）之间分摊成本。在不存在契约摩擦的情况下，除"就诊共付额"外，企业成本分摊可替代消费者成本分摊。最优企业契约取决于消费者与企业成本分摊之间的边际替代率。以医疗保险医师服务为例，提高预付比例但降低随支出递增的支付比例，可同时降低患者与医疗服务提供者的风险；在我们的校准模型中，其净收益是消除医疗补充保险外部性收益的两倍。对于处方药而言，一美元医师文书成本的影响效力是消费者成本分摊的45至110倍。

title: Unruly by Design: Fee Volatility and Strategic Attacks in Bitcoin Mining
title_zh: 设计失序：比特币挖矿中的费用波动与策略性攻击
title_primary: 设计失序：比特币挖矿中的费用波动与策略性攻击
title_secondary: Unruly by Design: Fee Volatility and Strategic Attacks in Bitcoin Mining
authors: Fabian Schär, Dario Thürkauf, David Yermack
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We develop a model of aberrant behavior by Bitcoin miners and test it with a new 2017-2025 dataset. Miners’ rewards, comprised partly of user fees, exhibit variability across blocks of transactions. When large reward disparities exist between adjacent blocks, miners have incentives to attempt alternative versions of prior blocks and claim other miners’ rewards for themselves. Regression analysis shows that fee differentials are associated with these attacks and longer waiting times between blocks. These patterns imply potential destabilization of the Bitcoin blockchain as future mining rewards become more volatile due to gradual withdrawal of fixed block subsidies.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个比特币矿工异常行为模型，并利用2017-2025年的新数据集进行检验。矿工收益部分来源于用户手续费，在不同交易区块间呈现波动性。当相邻区块间存在较大收益差异时，矿工有动机尝试篡改先前区块的替代版本，从而侵占其他矿工的收益。回归分析表明，手续费差异与这类攻击行为及区块间更长的等待时间存在关联。这些模式意味着，随着固定区块补贴逐步退出导致未来挖矿收益波动加剧，比特币区块链可能面临潜在的不稳定性风险。

title: The Urban Equilibrium Effects of Electric Vehicle Tax Credits
title_zh: 电动汽车税收抵免的城市均衡效应
title_primary: 电动汽车税收抵免的城市均衡效应
title_secondary: The Urban Equilibrium Effects of Electric Vehicle Tax Credits
authors: Weihua Zhao, William Larson, Becka Brolinson
source: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study extends the monocentric city model to incorporate endogenous household automobile fuel choice and dwelling energy consumption. Electric vehicle (EV) tax credits lower direct energy consumption and emissions via commuting but also cause important urban general equilibrium effects, including sprawl. This creates a substantial emissions rebound effect via larger homes, longer commutes, and greater consumption of the numeraire good. Nevertheless, EV tax credits are welfare enhancing unless electricity production is heavily tilted toward coal, with total household energy consumption and carbon emissions falling substantially.
abstract_zh: 本研究将单中心城市模型扩展至包含内生家庭汽车燃料选择和住宅能源消耗。电动汽车税收抵免通过通勤降低了直接能源消耗和排放，但也引发了重要的城市一般均衡效应，包括城市蔓延。这通过更大的住房、更长的通勤距离以及对计价商品消费的增加，产生了显著的排放反弹效应。尽管如此，除非电力生产严重偏向煤炭，电动汽车税收抵免仍能提升福利，且家庭总能源消耗和碳排放显著下降。

title: On the persistence of fluid identity: Insights from the decline of ethnic voting in Malawi
title_zh: 论流动身份的持续性：来自马拉维族群投票衰落的启示
title_primary: 论流动身份的持续性：来自马拉维族群投票衰落的启示
title_secondary: On the persistence of fluid identity: Insights from the decline of ethnic voting in Malawi
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Recent empirical evidence suggesting the malleability of identity raises the critical question of whether an updated identity, adapted to new environments, endures and under what conditions. To address this question, I analyze the 2009 parliamentary election in Malawi, during which the results deviated from historical voting patterns along ethno-regional lines. Specifically, the southern-based Democratic Progressive Party unexpectedly gained overwhelming support across the country, reducing the salience of local ethnic groups and signaling a drive for unity among historically divided societies. By comparing constituencies where this party barely won or lost, I find that the victory significantly reduced citizens’ sense of ethnic instead of national identity—particularly in rural areas historically aligned with opposition parties. This effect persisted for several years, coinciding with improvements in certain public goods and services, but dissipated within seven years. Furthermore, there is no evidence that selective migration across ethnic homelands, strategic downplaying of ethnic attachments, or post-election disillusionment with the party explains the identity shift, though these alternatives cannot be conclusively dismissed. These findings suggest that while identity can swiftly respond to socioeconomic shocks that alter group salience, it may revert to its original state unless further shocks or policies reinforce the altered identity.
abstract_zh: 近期实证证据表明身份认同具有可塑性，这引发了一个关键问题：适应新环境而更新的身份认同是否能够持久，以及在何种条件下得以持久。为解答此问题，我分析了2009年马拉维议会选举，此次选举结果偏离了历史上沿族群-地域界限的投票模式。具体而言，以南地区为根据地的民主进步党意外在全国范围内获得压倒性支持，削弱了地方族群的重要性，并标志着历史上分裂社会走向团结的驱动力。通过比较该党以微弱优势获胜或落败的选区，我发现该党的胜利显著降低了公民的族群认同感，而非国家认同感——尤其是在历史上与反对党结盟的农村地区。这一效应持续了数年，与某些公共产品和服务改善的时间相吻合，但在七年内逐渐消退。此外，没有证据表明选择性迁往族群故土、策略性淡化族群依附或选后对该党的失望情绪能解释这一身份转变，尽管这些替代解释无法被完全排除。这些发现表明，尽管身份认同能够迅速响应改变群体显著性的社会经济冲击，但除非有进一步的冲击或政策强化已改变的身份认同，否则它可能回归原初状态。

title: Temporary Programs, Lasting Questions: Ad Hoc Assistance in the U.S. Farm Safety Net
title_zh: 临时项目，持久问题：美国农业安全网中的临时援助
title_primary: 临时项目，持久问题：美国农业安全网中的临时援助
title_secondary: Temporary Programs, Lasting Questions: Ad Hoc Assistance in the U.S. Farm Safety Net
official: 官方在线 2026-06-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Large ad hoc assistance programs have returned to U.S. farm policy since 2017, operating alongside a more developed safety net built around federally subsidized crop insurance, Title I commodity programs, and standing disaster assistance. This paper reviews the renewed use of ad hoc assistance, documents its recent scale using USDA data, and examines its implications for producers and policy design. Repeated ad hoc programs may create expectations of future support while leaving uncertainty about timing, eligibility, and payment formulas. They also raise questions about crop insurance incentives, targeting, transparency, taxpayer exposure, and coordination across safety‐net tools.
abstract_zh: 摘要 自2017年以来，美国农业政策中重新出现了大规模临时援助计划，这些计划与围绕联邦补贴作物保险、第一标题商品计划及常设灾害援助构建的更为完善的安全网并行运作。本文回顾了临时援助的重新启用情况，利用美国农业部数据记录了其近期规模，并探讨了其对生产者及政策设计的影响。反复实施的临时计划可能形成对未来支持的预期，同时却在时间安排、资格认定及支付公式方面留下不确定性。此外，这些计划还引发了关于作物保险激励、目标定位、透明度、纳税人风险敞口以及安全网工具间协调性的问题。

title: The Short- and Long-Run Effects of Railroads on Mexico-US Migration
title_zh: 铁路对墨西哥-美国移民的短期与长期效应
title_primary: 铁路对墨西哥-美国移民的短期与长期效应
title_secondary: The Short- and Long-Run Effects of Railroads on Mexico-US Migration
official: 官方在线月份 2026-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper leverages variation in the access to the Mexican railroad network in the early 1900s to estimate its impact on migration to the United States and evaluate its long-run persistence after passenger rail service became obsolete. Using an IV strategy based on least-cost paths between historical cities, we find that locations with railroad access had migration rates four times higher than those without in the early twentieth century. Sequential migration was the key mechanism: railroads first facilitated internal mobility toward railroad hubs, then onward migration to the US. Railroad access also contributed to structural transformation, raising urbanization and local economic development. In terms of persistence, locations with historical railroad access show weakly lower total migration rates to the US in the early 21st century, consistent with local economic growth reducing the incentive to migrate. Yet destination-specific patterns prove remarkably durable: locations that disproportionately sent migrants to California, Arizona, or Texas in the 1900s continued to do so in the 2000s, reflecting the persistence of migrant networks.
abstract_zh: 本文利用20世纪初墨西哥铁路网通达性的差异，估计其对美国移民的影响，并评估客运铁路服务过时后的长期持续性。基于历史城市间最小成本路径的IV策略，我们发现，20世纪初拥有铁路通达性的地区移民率是未通达地区的四倍。顺序迁移是关键机制：铁路首先促进人口向铁路枢纽的内部流动，进而推动向美国的后续迁移。铁路通达性还促进了结构转型，提高了城市化水平和地方经济发展。在持续性方面，拥有历史铁路通达性的地区在21世纪初对美国的总体移民率略低，这与地方经济增长降低了移民动机相一致。然而，目的地特定模式表现出显著的持久性：20世纪主要向加利福尼亚、亚利桑那或得克萨斯输送移民的地区，在21世纪仍保持这一趋势，反映了移民网络的持续性。

title: 'Nobody Wants to Work Anymore': Lifetime Labor Market Experiences and the Decline of Male LFP in the United States

official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Male labor force participation has declined steadily for 50 years in the United States. We show that one cause has been changes in men's beliefs about the returns to work, shaped by lifetime experiences of the aggregate male labor market. We find that experience effects on participation persist for men who move across state lines, are stronger for same-race male experiences, and are driven by formative childhood years. We also document effects of experiences on direct measures of labor market expectations. Our findings suggest that experience effects can turn short-run declines in labor demand into long-run declines in labor supply.
abstract_zh: 美国男性劳动力参与率在过去50年间持续下降。研究表明，其中一个原因是男性对工作回报的信念发生了变化，而这种信念受到其一生中整体男性劳动力市场经历的影响。我们发现，跨州迁移的男性仍会保留经历对参与率的影响，且同种族男性经历的影响更为显著，这种影响主要源于童年关键成长期。我们还证实了经历对劳动力市场预期直接测度指标的作用。研究结果表明，经历效应可能将劳动力需求的短期下降转化为劳动力供给的长期萎缩。

title: Digital twin enabled land administration systems: A multi-dimensional comparative assessment and policy pathways for Turkey
title_zh: 数字孪生赋能的地籍管理系统：土耳其的多维比较评估与政策路径
title_primary: 数字孪生赋能的地籍管理系统：土耳其的多维比较评估与政策路径
title_secondary: Digital twin enabled land administration systems: A multi-dimensional comparative assessment and policy pathways for Turkey
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Digital twin technologies are increasingly promoted to move land administration from static, two-dimensional information systems toward dynamic platforms that support real-time governance. Yet most existing studies focus on single-country pilots or narrow technical design, offering limited insight into how digital twins are embedded in legal, institutional and participatory frameworks. This paper develops and applies an eight-dimension comparative framework to examine Digital Twin–enabled Land Administration Systems (DT-LAS) in eight jurisdictions (South Korea, Singapore, China, the Netherlands, Finland, the United Kingdom, Australia and Canada), with Turkey analysed as an emerging adopter. Methodologically, the study combines structured document analysis of national strategies, international standards and peer-reviewed research with an evidence-informed maturity scoring system, synthesised in a cross-country matrix and a two-mode country–dimension network visualisation. The analysis shows that data interoperability and sustainability function as central structural hubs within the global DT-LAS landscape, whereas citizen participation consistently emerges as the weakest dimension. High DT-LAS maturity is associated not only with advanced three-dimensional (3D) and four-dimensional (4D) cadastre, Internet of Things (IoT) and Building Information Modelling (BIM) integration, but also with investment in standards-based spatial data infrastructures, cross-agency coordination and evolving cultures of citizen engagement. Turkey demonstrates strong cadastral digitisation capacity through the Land Registry and Cadastre Information System (TAKBIS) and the Spatial Property System (MEGSIS) but remains constrained by fragmented institutional arrangements and limited participatory mechanisms. The paper proposes a context-sensitive implementation roadmap for Turkey, linking technical capacity with legal, institutional and participatory reforms.
abstract_zh: 数字孪生技术日益被推广，旨在将土地管理从静态的二维信息系统转向支持实时治理的动态平台。然而，现有研究大多聚焦于单一国家的试点或狭隘的技术设计，对数字孪生如何嵌入法律、制度及参与式框架的洞察有限。本文开发并应用了一个八维度比较框架，考察八个司法管辖区（韩国、新加坡、中国、荷兰、芬兰、英国、澳大利亚和加拿大）中的数字孪生赋能土地管理系统（DT-LAS），并将土耳其作为新兴采纳者进行分析。方法上，本研究将国家战略、国际标准和同行评审研究的结构化文献分析与基于证据的成熟度评分系统相结合，通过跨国矩阵和双模式国家-维度网络可视化进行综合。分析表明，数据互操作性和可持续性在全球DT-LAS格局中充当核心结构枢纽，而公民参与始终是最薄弱的维度。高DT-LAS成熟度不仅与先进的三维（3D）和四维（4D）地籍、物联网（IoT）及建筑信息模型（BIM）集成相关，还与对基于标准的地理空间数据基础设施的投资、跨机构协调以及不断发展的公民参与文化相关。土耳其通过土地登记和地籍信息系统（TAKBIS）及空间财产系统（MEGSIS）展现出强大的地籍数字化能力，但仍受制于碎片化的制度安排和有限的参与机制。本文为土耳其提出了一条情境敏感的实施方案路线图，将技术能力与法律、制度及参与式改革相衔接。

title: Growth-at-Risk Is Investment-at-Risk
title_zh: 增长风险即投资风险
title_primary: 增长风险即投资风险
title_secondary: Growth-at-Risk Is Investment-at-Risk
authors: Aaron J. Amburgey, Michael W. McCracken
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We investigate the role financial conditions play in the composition of U.S. growth-at-risk. We document that, by a wide margin, growth-at-risk is investment-at-risk. That is, if financial conditions indicate U.S. real GDP growth will be in the lower tail of its conditional distribution, we know that quantitatively, the main contributor is a decline in investment. Consumption contributes under extreme financial stress. Government spending and net exports do not play a role. We show that leverage plays a key role in determining both consumption- and investment-at-risk, which provides support to the financial accelerator mechanism proposed by Bernanke et al. (1999).
abstract_zh: 我们研究了金融状况在美国增长风险构成中的作用。实证表明，增长风险在很大程度上即为投资风险。也就是说，若金融状况预示美国实际GDP增长将处于条件分布的下尾端，从量化角度看，其主要贡献因素来自投资下降。消费仅在极端金融压力下有所贡献，而政府支出与净出口则未发挥显著作用。我们进一步发现，杠杆水平在决定消费风险与投资风险中均扮演关键角色，这为Bernanke等（1999）提出的金融加速器机制提供了实证支持。

title: A note on the strategic vulnerability of the Boston mechanism in random markets
title_zh: 关于随机市场中波士顿机制策略脆弱性的一个注记

title_secondary: A note on the strategic vulnerability of the Boston mechanism in random markets
official: 官方在线 2026-03-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We provide the first asymptotic analysis of the Boston Mechanism under equilibrium play in random markets. We provide two results. First, while 63% of students receive their first preference under truthful reporting–outperforming any other known mechanism in the literature–this rate converges to zero in any Nash equilibrium of the corresponding preference revelation game as the market size grows. Second, we show there exists a Nash equilibrium where the average student receives a dramatically inferior assignment: in markets with 1,000 students, the average placement shifts from the 7th choice (under truthfulness) to the 145th choice, representing a change from logarithmic to nearly linear average rank.
abstract_zh: 我们首次对随机市场中均衡行为下的波士顿机制进行了渐近分析。我们提供了两项结果。第一，尽管在真实报告下，63%的学生能获得其首选偏好——这一比例超越了文献中任何其他已知机制——但在相应的偏好揭示博弈中，随着市场规模扩大，这一比例在任何纳什均衡下都趋近于零。第二，我们证明存在一个纳什均衡，其中平均学生获得的分配结果显著恶化：在拥有1000名学生的市场中，平均分配位置从第7选择（在真实报告下）移至第145选择，这标志着平均排名从对数级转变为近乎线性级。

title: Incapacitating the Competition: The Impact of Vertical Restraints on Technology Adoption
title_zh: 削弱竞争：纵向约束对技术采纳的影响
title_primary: 削弱竞争：纵向约束对技术采纳的影响
title_secondary: Incapacitating the Competition: The Impact of Vertical Restraints on Technology Adoption
official: 官方在线 2026-01-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Vertical restraints imposed on some downstream buyers can affect non-contracted firms by weakening upstream suppliers’ effective viability. We study these contracting externalities using Intel’s exclusionary agreements with PC manufacturers in the microprocessor market. Combining litigation-based measures of restraints with PC data, we estimate dynamic models of AMD adoption that allow for cross-buyer spillovers. We find that exclusivity imposed on a given buyer significantly reduces adoption by other, non-contracted buyers, generating sizable and persistent market-wide effects. The paper provides the first empirical quantification of the economic magnitude of contracting externalities and highlights the broader competitive risks posed by exclusionary contracting.
abstract_zh: 对部分下游买家施加的纵向限制可能通过削弱上游供应商的有效生存能力，对非签约企业产生影响。本文利用英特尔在微处理器市场与个人电脑制造商签订的排他性协议，研究此类契约外部性。通过将基于诉讼的约束措施与个人电脑数据相结合，我们估计了允许跨买家溢出效应的AMD采纳动态模型。研究发现，对特定买家施加的排他性条款会显著降低其他非签约买家的采纳率，产生规模可观且持续的市场整体效应。本文首次对契约外部性的经济规模进行实证量化，揭示了排他性契约带来的更广泛竞争风险。

title: The Changing Nature of Firm Innovation: Short-Termism and Influential Innovation in U.S. Public Firms
title_primary: The Changing Nature of Firm Innovation: Short-Termism and Influential Innovation in U.S. Public Firms
authors: Yuan Shi, Rachelle C. Sampson, Brent Goldfarb, Rafael A. Corredoira
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2025-12-19 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine the link between short-term pressures and technologically significant innovation in U.S. public firms in 1997–2015. Using a market-based measure of short-term pressure, we estimate its relationship with influential and novel patents. We find that firms facing more intense short-term pressures are less likely to patent highly influential or novel innovations. To evaluate whether this relationship is causal, we use changes in ownership styles following financial institution mergers as instruments. Our analysis suggests that changing short-term pressures from investors had a causal impact on firm innovative outcomes; this finding is robust to a wide variety of empirical specifications. While public firms as a whole retained a constant share of highly influential patents, this activity has become more concentrated in fewer firms. This shift does not appear to be fully compensated by an increase in technologically significant patents by nonpublic firms such as venture-capital (VC)-backed start-ups. These findings raise questions about capital markets’ impact on firm R&D strategy and the nature of innovative activities in public firms. This paper was accepted by Ashish Arora, entrepreneurship and innovation. B. Goldfarb and R. Corredoira received partial financial support from the National Science Foundation [Grant 1565553]. title: The central vertical regulation and urban green development: a study based on the ambient air quality standards
title_zh: 中央垂直监管与城市绿色发展：基于环境空气质量标准的研究

authors: Deheng Xiao Meng Xun Jingbo Fan School of Government, University of International Business and Economics, Beijing, China
official: 官方在线 2025-08-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Urban green development is not just a modern urban planning necessity, it’s also a vital strategy for achieving sustainable growth, enhancing city competitiveness, and improving residents’ quality of life. In 2012, China introduced the ambient air quality standards policy to propel the nation’s green development. Using a sample of 268 prefecture-level cities in China from 2006 to 2020, this paper investigates the impact of centralized vertical regulation on urban green development using DID model. The results demonstrate that centralized vertical regulation greatly enhances urban green development. The mechanism tests suggest that centralized vertical regulation encourages green development by increasing government investments in environmental protection, optimizing financial and technological capabilities, and raising public awareness of environmental issues. Next, the research highlights that centralized vertical regulation more significantly influences urban green development in central and western cities, those with limited innovation capacity cities, and cities less dependent on protection of property rights. Finally, the economic analysis concludes that centralized vertical regulation not only benefits green environmental outcomes but also drives high-quality economic growth in China.
abstract_zh: 城市绿色发展不仅是现代城市规划的必然要求，也是实现可持续增长、提升城市竞争力及改善居民生活质量的关键策略。2012年，中国实施了环境空气质量标准政策，旨在推动国家绿色发展。本文利用2006年至2020年间中国268个地级市的数据，采用双重差分模型探讨了中央垂直监管对城市绿色发展的影响。研究结果显示，中央垂直监管显著促进了城市绿色发展。机制检验表明，中央垂直监管通过增加政府环保投入、优化财政与科技能力以及提升公众环保意识来推动绿色发展。进一步研究发现，中央垂直监管对中部和西部城市、创新能力有限的城市以及产权保护依赖度较低的城市，其绿色发展影响更为显著。最后，经济分析指出，中央垂直监管不仅有利于绿色环境成果，还促进了中国高质量的经济增长。
